specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.12.0 rules remain active. This version adds one more way to separate the suite from PUAddress and DOAddress.

specification.description: v2.13.0 overlay: a single trailing letter is the suite (3300 VISTA WAY A gives Dropoff Address 3300 VISTA WAY and Dropoff Suite A), except for post-directionals N, S, E and W (2732 LOKER AVE W stays whole).

changes: ADDRESS-SUITE-003: a single trailing letter is the suite. 3300 VISTA WAY A, 1622 BROADWAY A and 1259 NATOMA WAY C give Suite A, A and C (CFS 11.23.26, expected output given by Majo, 2026-11-23).

Conditions: the address starts with a house number; the letter is not N, S, E or W, because those are post-directionals that belong to the street name (2732 LOKER AVE W, 184 TERRACE DR E); the street has at least 1 word after a leading directional; its last word is not a highway word (HWY, HIGHWAY, ROUTE, RTE, SR, I, INTERSTATE, US, CR, COUNTY, FM, BOX); and the street is not only a street type whose name is the letter (100 AVENUE C, 20 N AVE D stay whole).
The suite is the letter as received (A). Addresses with an indicator (APT B, #B), a trailing number, or no trailing letter do not change.
Added acceptance tests AT-88 to AT-90.

trailing_letter.one_word_street_type_note: When the street (after a leading directional) is a single street-type word (AVENUE, AVE, ST, WAY, ...), the letter is the street name: 100 AVENUE C stays whole.

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Address without the letter; Suite A, A and C
